csv_scope_of_work: Sam Houston State University ( Owner ) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications ( Qualifications ) for the selection of a firm ( Consultant ) to provide Indefinite Quantity-Indefinite Delivery ( IDIQ ) Structural Engineering ( STRUCTURAL ) services for planning, design, renovation and new construction of projects for Sam Houston State University, Huntsville, Texas( Owner ) on an hourly fee orlump sum basis as needed by the Owner. Expected required services include, but are not limited to, pre-project planning, cost estimating, programming, design, construction document preparation, bidding assistance, and construction phase administration, or any other service that is beneficial in the delivery of facilities. The STRUCTURAL will render these services to the Owner as needed, with no minimum or maximum amount of services specified. In particular, the STRUCTURAL must be prepared to assign at least one person with significant project planning and management experience to be available as the point of contact for all efforts at the Owner

raw_text: Current Date: 7/16/2026 Original Date: 6/4/2025 Project #: 813097-1 Project Name: Structural Engineering Services for SHSU Target Market: Universities/Colleges County: Walker State: Southern Texas Agency: Sam Houston State University AgencyID: 101 Location: Huntsville, TX Scope of Work: Sam Houston State University ( Owner ) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications ( Qualifications ) for the selection of a firm ( Consultant ) to provide Indefinite Quantity-Indefinite Delivery ( IDIQ ) Structural Engineering ( STRUCTURAL ) services for planning, design, renovation and new construction of projects for Sam Houston State University, Huntsville, Texas( Owner ) on an hourly fee orlump sum basis as needed by the Owner. Expected required services include, but are not limited to, pre-project planning, cost estimating, programming, design, construction document preparation, bidding assistance, and construction phase administration, or any other service that is beneficial in the delivery of facilities. The STRUCTURAL will render these services to the Owner as needed, with no minimum or maximum amount of services specified. In particular, the STRUCTURAL must be prepared to assign at least one person with significant project planning and management experience to be available as the point of contact for all efforts at the Owner Disciplines Requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering Comments: '- Project Number: 753-26-00033- Contract Value: $1.5M- Contract Participation Goal: Prevailing Wage- Prevailing wage rates may apply.- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 07/29/2026 05:00 PM CDT - Question Contact: Jennifer Niemiec Email: jjn014@shsu.edu Contract Duration: Y Renewable: Y Base Period: 24 Renewal Option: 12 Stage: RFP/RFQ Submittal Deadline: 8/5/2026 02:00 PM CDT Contact Name: Charles Jones Contact Phone: 936-294-3677 Contact Fax: 936-294-3882 Contact Email: cjones@shsu.edu Website: https://www.txsmartbuy.gov/esbd/753-26-00033 ProjectID: 1018177 DR #: '202500241654
